framework.cell: orthorhombic Pnma cell, 288 atoms, 20.14 x 19.51 x 13.10 A

gm: buckled Au6 (10 Au-Au bonds, mean 2.75 A) anchored to the wall of the channel intersection by four Au-O 2.24-2.29 A contacts, Au-Si >= 2.88 A; binding to the frozen framework -1.8 eV
notes: Pilot: 10 seeds x BH/RS, 40k steps (campaign pilot-bze1-v3). The originally planned Pd4 (and Pd6, Pd8; campaign pilot-bze1) was dropped: NEP89 bonds Pd (and Pt) atoms to SiO4 edges of MFI with M-Si 2.40-2.47 A, an artefact; Au does not do this (Au-Si >= 2.88 A). Au size scan (BH/RS ERT): Au5 5.7k/25k (distinct isomer exactly at +0.020 eV), Au6 8.6k/31.5k, Au7 11.8k/9.2k (no harder for RS than for BH); Au6 chosen. 13/20 runs reached the GM (energy spread 1.2 meV); 3 RS runs ended in distorted variants of the GM at +0.011-0.019 eV (hits with e_tol 0.02); distinct isomers start at +0.057 eV, so BH SR does not depend on e_tol in [0.002, 0.056]. Budget = 3 x median BH hit (3.8k) = 11k steps (~4 min/run). NEP89 narrows the smallest Si-O-Si angles of MFI (min 122.7 vs 132 deg in the IZA CIF); NEP89 is not fitted to metal/zeolite interfaces, cluster-framework binding is qualitative.
